title: Enumerate

inlines.v: ENU'MERATE, verb transitive [Latin enumero; e and numero, numerus, number.] To count or tell, number by number; to reckon or mention a number of things, each separately; as, to enumerate the stars in a constellation; to enumerate particular acts of kindness; we cannot enumerate our daily mercies.
